nativeCommandLines.command: /bin/bash -lc "python3 browser.py open 1024 768 && python3 browser.py view && python3 browser.py inspect '#office' && python3 browser.py inspect '#send' && python3 browser.py click '#send' && python3 browser.py view && python3 browser.py press Shift+Tab && python3 browser.py press Tab && python3 browser.py inspect '#send'"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess

def browser(*args):
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output([\"python3\", \"browser.py\", *args]))

for width, height in [(1024, 768), (320, 720)]:
    browser(\"open\", str(width), str(height))
    primary = browser(\"inspect\", \"#office\")[\"result\"][\"visual\"]
    send = browser(\"inspect\", \"#send\")[\"result\"]
    clear = browser(\"inspect\", \"#clear\")[\"result\"]
    for prop in (\"bg\", \"color\", \"border\", \"weight\", \"radius\"):
        assert send[\"visual\"][prop] == primary[prop], (width, prop, send)
    assert clear[\"visual\"][\"bg\"] == \"rgb(255, 255, 255)\", clear
    assert clear[\"visual\"][\"color\"] == \"rgb(20, 43, 58)\", clear
    for button in (send, clear):
        x, _, w, _ = button[\"bounds\"]
        assert 0 <= x and x + w <= width, button

    for control in (\"office\", \"vessel\", \"slot\", \"clear\", \"send\"):
        assert browser(\"press\", \"Tab\")[\"active\"][\"id\"] == control, control
    assert browser(\"press\", \"Enter\")[\"status\"] == \"Enter a vessel name.\"
    corrected = browser(\"inspect\", \"#send\")[\"result\"]
    assert corrected[\"focused\"] and corrected[\"visual\"][\"outline\"] == \"rgb(177, 77, 31) solid 3px\", corrected
    assert corrected[\"visual\"][\"bg\"] == primary[\"bg\"], corrected
    secondary = browser(\"press\", \"Shift+Tab\")[\"active\"]
    assert secondary[\"id\"] == \"clear\" and secondary[\"visual\"][\"outline\"] == corrected[\"visual\"][\"outline\"], secondary
    assert browser(\"press\", \"Space\")[\"status\"] == \"\"
    browser(\"fill\", \"#vessel\", \"  Sample Vessel  \")
    browser(\"select\", \"#slot\", \"Afternoon\")
    assert browser(\"click\", \"#send\")[\"status\"] == \"Arrival requested for Sample Vessel · Afternoon.\"
    assert browser(\"click\", \"#clear\")[\"status\"] == \"\"
    assert browser(\"inspect\", \"#vessel\")[\"result\"][\"value\"] == \"\"
    assert browser(\"inspect\", \"#slot\")[\"result\"][\"value\"] == \"Morning\"
    print(f\"{width} × {height}: button hierarchy, keyboard focus, correction, booking confirmation, and reset passed\")
PY"
